decks.name: The Whispering Forest
decks.flavour: Birds sing off-key. The trees clap politely.

rooms.flavour: The path narrows. Something heavy breathes behind a fern.
A sunny glade. Too sunny. Something rustles.
Old trees, older shadows, newest danger.
A stone circle hums a riddle only a clear sentence can answer.
Vines twitch. This is a trap and it is proud of it.
A hunter's cache: coins, a compass, half a sandwich.
A mossy clearing. The fire crackles an old folk song.
A white stag crosses the path and nods once, respectfully.
The heart of the forest. Every branch turns toward you.

decks.name: The Cold Crypt
decks.flavour: Dust, old candles, and very patient residents.

rooms.flavour: A hall of tombs. One lid slides open by itself.
Your footsteps echo back with the wrong rhythm.
A coffin-shaped guard post. Guard included.
An epitaph is half worn away. Read it aloud to finish it.
Loose tiles. The floor has a sense of humour.
Offering plates from centuries of guilty travellers.
A small chapel. The candles light themselves for you.
A cold wind carries a voice: it only says the word 'soon'.
The throne of the Baron. He stands up. He bows. Then he attacks.

decks.name: The Sunken Ruins
decks.flavour: Broken columns, stubborn pigeons, older magic.

rooms.flavour: A gatehouse. The gate has opinions about visitors.
A courtyard of broken statues. One statue blinks.
The vault door lost its key but kept its temper.
Ancient words wait for a clear, correct reading aloud.
Some tiles are floors. Others are lies.
The treasury of a kingdom that forgot to lock it.
A library nook that survived everything, including the roof.
Ghostly trumpets announce a parade that ended 800 years ago.
The central hall. The Sentinel wakes and asks for the password.
